metric_definitions.operator_occurrence: Counts every MongoDB operator key beginning with '$' across all stages and nested expressions.
metric_definitions.operator_presence: Counts each MongoDB operator at most once per record.
metric_definitions.stage_occurrence: Counts top-level aggregation pipeline stages; a record can contribute multiple occurrences of the same stage.
metric_definitions.stage_presence: Counts each top-level aggregation stage at most once per record.
metric_definitions.mql_skeleton_signature: Field/literal-abstracted MQL skeleton signature computed from the public MQL.
metric_definitions.stage_sequence: Top-level stage operator sequence derived from the public MQL.
metric_definitions.nested_dotted_path: Approximate static MQL signal: record has at least one dotted field path reference in the parsed pipeline.

detailed_pipeline_stage_statistics.dataset_source: public lean release records with fields: record_id, db_id, NLQ, NLQ_colloquial, MQL

metric_definitions.stage_occurrence: Top-level aggregation stage occurrences; a record can contribute multiple occurrences of the same stage.
metric_definitions.stage_presence: Per-record stage presence; each stage counted at most once per record.
metric_definitions.position_1_based: Absolute 1-based index in the aggregation pipeline.
metric_definitions.position_bucket: first, early, middle, late, or last position normalized by pipeline length.
metric_definitions.transition: Adjacent top-level stage pair inside a pipeline.
metric_definitions.structural_bucket: Coarse stage-structure family derived from presence of $unwind, $group, repeated unwind, $addFields, and repeated projection.
